verdict.line: You win by forcing all-ins before level 6 with Lunge resets and a timed Riposte; you lose if the lane drifts to 20+ minutes and his stacked Siphoning Strike plus Fury of the Sands take over.

brief.thesis: Nasus's Q (Siphoning Strike) permanently increases its own damage every time it lands the killing blow on a minion or champion, so even a calm, farm-even lane is a slow win for him. Fiora's tools are front-loaded for levels 1-6 dueling and he has no gap-closer before then — his only threats are the short 255-range Q and the 700-range Wither (W) slow. That's why Fiora holds the lane and solo-kill advantage on paper, yet the measured head-to-head sits at only 47.5% over 1797 games: most Fiora players don't close the lane out before his stacks and ultimate make up the difference.

theirWindow.what: Once he's 6 he'll Wither (W) to drag down your Move and Attack Speed before committing — if you're already slowed when he walks up, back off rather than trading, since the slow escalates the longer it sits on you.

yourWindow.when: he's mid Siphoning Strike on a minion
yourWindow.what: Siphoning Strike is only 255 range, so every time he steps up to last-hit he's inside your 600-range Lunge (Q) — hit him with Q whenever he's in range, then the second free dash if he tries to walk off.

start.why: 94.6% pick rate and 47.1% WR here — the lifesteal and AD keep you winning the short trades Lunge sets up without needing to all-in.

boots.why: 49.8% pick, 43.7% WR — flat damage reduction blunts his repeated Siphoning Strike autos during farm-trade exchanges.

core.why: Highest-winrate path (54.9% over 368 games) into Trinity Force then Death's Dance — the healing and wave clear let you match his sustain while you're still ahead.
Spikes damage and move speed right as his Wither starts threatening to stick you in trades.
Caps burst damage and keeps you alive through his delayed Spirit Fire poke and ultimate drain.

his soul eater lifesteal is sustaining him through your all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards consecutive autos — stacking it during your E (Burst of Speed) attack-speed window turns a short trade window into real burst against his low mobility.

summoners.why: 89.5% pick rate at 47.9% WR — Ignite converts your pre-6 solo-kill advantage into an actual kill and shuts down his Soul Eater sustain during the all-in.

playing.title: Lunge him off every CS
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike's 255 range forces him to walk up to minions — hit him with Q whenever he's inside your 600 range, then use the free second dash if he disengages.

playing.title: Save Riposte for his all-in
playing.detail: Once he's 6 and commits with Wither, parry his next auto with W (Riposte) to deny his main damage source and burst him with the AD buff instead.

playing.title: Watch his Q stacks, not just gold
playing.detail: Every minion kill makes Siphoning Strike permanently stronger — if he's farming freely under tower, treat that as the lane slipping even if the CS count looks even.

playing.title: Kill before level 6 if you can
playing.detail: You hold the solo-kill advantage pre-6 when he has no gap-closer; chain E (Burst of Speed) autos with Lunge resets to force a trade he can't walk away from.

playing.title: Step out of Spirit Fire, don't fight in it
playing.detail: His E is a ground-targeted zone on a 12s cooldown that shreds armor over time — disengage rather than trading inside the flame.

playing.title: Close the game before 20 minutes
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands drains nearby enemies' max HP into bonus damage while active — the longer the game runs, the more his ultimate and stacks erase your early lead.

playing.title: Use Blade Waltz to finish, not to chase evenly
playing.detail: R resets around the fight for burst on isolated targets, but successive hits on the same target deal reduced damage — don't tunnel him alone in a teamfight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are this brief's own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Nasus grow by applying pressure. Hit him with [Q] whenever he stands in range. Hit him with [W] to kill him after reaching level 6.
